_comment: Search titles and descriptions for the generated guide and macro pages. Kept out of build-site.mjs so copy can be tuned without touching the generator, and out of the Markdown so the app's help text stays identical to the site's. A slug with no entry here falls back to the document's own H1 and first paragraph, which is worse for search but never blocks a build. primaryKeyword is documentation, not used by the build: it records what each page is meant to win so the next person editing the title knows what not to break.

_fields.title: the <title> tag, with ' | SwMacroFlow' appended by the build
_fields.heading: optional. Overrides the page's H1 only. Macro pages use it to put the keyword in the heading while the cards and sidebars keep the name the desktop app shows.
_fields.navTitle: optional. Overrides the label in sidebars, index cards and prev/next links.
_fields.primaryKeyword: documentation only, not read by the build

overview.title: What SwMacroFlow does - SOLIDWORKS batch macro runner
overview.description: How SwMacroFlow opens each SOLIDWORKS file once, runs every macro you ticked against it in order, and records what each macro reported.
overview.heading: What SwMacroFlow does

using-the-app.title: Using SwMacroFlow to run a SOLIDWORKS macro batch
using-the-app.description: A panel-by-panel walkthrough: connect to SOLIDWORKS, pick files and folders, choose macros, fill in inputs, and read the results of a batch run.
using-the-app.primaryKeyword: run solidworks macro on multiple files

writing-a-macro.title: How to write a SOLIDWORKS VBA macro for batch running
writing-a-macro.description: Any SOLIDWORKS VBA macro with an argument-less Sub main works in SwMacroFlow - no library to reference and no host-specific code. With a worked example.

adding-inputs.title: Add user inputs to a SOLIDWORKS VBA macro
adding-inputs.description: Declare one Const per input with an @Name token and SwMacroFlow builds the control, validates what is typed, and substitutes the value before the macro runs.

reporting-results.title: Report macro results with MsgBox in a SOLIDWORKS batch
reporting-results.description: During a SwMacroFlow batch no dialog opens: each MsgBox call becomes that file's row in the results list instead, coloured by the icon constant you pass.

macro-authoring-spec.title: SOLIDWORKS macro authoring spec for SwMacroFlow
macro-authoring-spec.description: The complete contract for a macro that runs under SwMacroFlow, stated in one page - ready to paste into an AI assistant when generating a SOLIDWORKS macro.

troubleshooting.title: SOLIDWORKS macro batch errors and how to fix them
troubleshooting.description: Symptom-first fixes for SwMacroFlow: cannot reach SOLIDWORKS, macros that will not run, elevation mismatches, and files that fail part-way through a batch.

save-pdf.title: Batch export SOLIDWORKS to PDF - free VBA macro
save-pdf.description: A free SOLIDWORKS VBA macro that exports the open document to PDF. Works on parts, assemblies and drawings, and runs across whole folders in SwMacroFlow.
save-pdf.heading: Save PDF: export SOLIDWORKS files to PDF

change-document-unit.title: Change SOLIDWORKS document units in bulk - free macro
change-document-unit.description: A free SOLIDWORKS VBA macro that sets the document unit system and the individual length, angle, mass, volume, time, force, power and energy units.
change-document-unit.heading: Change Document Unit: set SOLIDWORKS units in bulk

change-drawing-template.title: Batch change SOLIDWORKS drawing sheet format (.slddrt)
change-drawing-template.description: A free SOLIDWORKS VBA macro that applies a .slddrt sheet format to one sheet, several named sheets, or every sheet in a drawing, then rebuilds and saves.
change-drawing-template.heading: Change Drawing Template: swap the .slddrt sheet format

insert-block-in-drawings.title: Insert a block into every SOLIDWORKS drawing sheet
insert-block-in-drawings.description: A free SOLIDWORKS VBA macro that inserts a .sldblk sketch block at a fixed position on one sheet, several named sheets, or every sheet in a drawing.
insert-block-in-drawings.heading: Insert Block In Drawings: add a .sldblk to every sheet

save-with-performance-improvement.title: Reduce SOLIDWORKS file size - batch image quality macro
save-with-performance-improvement.description: A free SOLIDWORKS VBA macro that turns image quality down to its cheapest settings, shaded deviation at maximum and high-quality edges off, then saves a copy.
save-with-performance-improvement.heading: Save with Performance Improvement: shrink SOLIDWORKS files
